name: P1, P2, P3, P4, SIV, Guided Flying
benefit: **Beneficiaries can work in firms operating as:** - Tandem Pilots - Instructors - Competitors
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 30 years of age. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy. > The total number of 215 beneficiaries will be selected.
